purpose: run workloads on cloud accounts and services that are organized, secured and cost-aware from the start
entry_criteria: Cloud provider and account structure decisions exist
Workload requirements and environments are known
Identity provider and billing ownership are defined
procedure: Separate accounts or projects by environment and by risk; production is isolated from the others.
Federate identity, use roles with least privilege, and disable long-lived user keys.
Set guardrails: allowed regions and services, mandatory encryption, logging to a separate account, and budget alerts.
Provision the hosting resources from code, tagged with owner, environment and cost center.
Enable audit logging and threat-detection services and route alerts to the on-call team.
Review cost and access monthly and remove unused resources.
acceptance_criteria: Production is isolated from other environments
No long-lived access keys for people
Audit logging is on and centralized
Budget alerts exist and resources carry owner tags

validation.command: aws iam list-users --query 'Users[].UserName'   # example; expect no routine human IAM users

validation.check: list resources without an owner tag

failure_modes.detection: No audit trail for a change

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Production runs in its own account reached only by federated roles, audit logs flow to a security account, and a monthly review removes two idle databases.
